name: CIT168 parcellation of human subcortical brain nuclei
summary: Generates a subject-specific parcellation of subcortical nuclei by registering the CIT168 probabilistic atlas (Pauli et al. 2018) to a T1-weighted image with atlaskit and thresholding the warped probabilities at 0.5.
description: Registers the CIT168 700 um T1w template to the subject T1 with the atlaskit tmp2ind_T1 script, warps the lateralised CIT168 probabilistic atlas into subject space and converts it to a deterministic parcellation (probability above 0.5). Use it to obtain subcortical nuclei ROIs (for example for tractography or connectomics). Needs a whole-head (not brain-extracted) T1w image.

inputs.description: This is the T1 image which will be have its subcortical regions parcellated and labeled.

outputs.description: This is a 3D, volumetric parcellation of subcortical regions(in nifti format) of the associated input T1 image

citations.text: Pauli W., Nili A., Tyszka J. A high-resolution probabilistic in vivo atlas of human subcortical brain nuclei. Sci Data 5, 180063 (2018).
Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
